bullets.title: “The Risk of Discovery”
bullets.note: essay by Paul Graham ([@paulg](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/38uml98xxakh9ngvk/opfkhq/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9wYXVsZw==))**, which is only a few paragraphs long. It’s worth rereading a few times.

bullets.section: What has been saving my ass —
bullets.title: Petzl TIKKA headlamp
bullets.note: There are a million headlamps out there, and there has been a creeping complexity. As filmmaker Morgan Spurlock once said [in our podcast together](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/38uml98xxakh9ngvk/pnceh9/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE2LzAzLzI5L21vcmdhbi1zcHVybG9jay1pbnNpZGUtdGhlLW1pbmQtb2YtYS1odW1hbi1ndWluZWEtcGlnLw==), “Once you get fancy, fancy gets broken.” The TIKKA is the right blend of power and simplicity, with two light colors (white and red), and a single operating button. I recently returned from the rainforest, and this was my only source of light for nearly 10 days.

bullets.section: What I’ve been traveling with… just in case —
bullets.title: “Trauma Pak” with QuikClot
bullets.note: When in the middle of nowhere, it’s nice to have at least one of these on hand. QuikClot itself, originally used for combat applications, is fascinating (check out [its Wikipedia page](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/38uml98xxakh9ngvk/60aeh8/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvUXVpa0Nsb3Q=)). Official description: “This Trauma Pak with QuikClot Advanced Clotting Sponge is designed to control bleeding at the scene so more advanced care can be sought later… Packed in a tough, waterproof, pocket-sized pouch, the Trauma Pak with QuikClot is easy to use: simply open, remove, and apply. Also included is an information pamphlet on treating injuries.”

bullets.section: Location I am considering traveling to —
bullets.title: Chaco Culture National Historical Park
bullets.note: [](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/38uml98xxakh9ngvk/52hvh7/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubnBzLmdvdi9jaGN1L2luZGV4Lmh0bQ==)** in New Mexico. It is considered one of the best places on earth to stargaze, and I would love to attend some of [their night sky programs](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/38uml98xxakh9ngvk/2ou2ho/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubnBzLmdvdi9jaGN1L3BsYW55b3VydmlzaXQvbmlnaHRza3kuaHRt).
